name: 3. Positive - Corporate Business Trip Booking -- @1.1

steps.name: Given I navigate to the MakeMyTrip homepage
And I dismiss the login popup and click on the hotels module
When I search for the hotel destination "Bali"
And I trigger the search query
And I apply the 5-star filter on the results page
And I select the first hotel and click Book Now
And I fill guest details with valid information for "Positive_Business_Booking"
And I handle secure trip and continue
Then the system should transition to the payment gateway
